name: Pantheon Secrets
description: Integration for Key module with Pantheon secrets
project_description:
Pantheon Secrets integration with the Key module.

 This module provides Drupal integration with the Pantheon Secrets EA Program in the form of a Key Provider plugin for the Key module.

 This module is compatible with PHP 8.2-8.5.

 Back to top 

 Install 
 Install as you would normally do with composer:

 composer require drupal/pantheon_secrets:^1 

 Back to top 

 Usage 
 Read the module's README to get up to speed using it.

 For real time discussion of the module find Pantheon developers in our Community Slack . Bug reports and feature requests should be posted in the drupal.org issue queue. For code changes, please submit pull requests against the GitHub repository rather than posting patches to drupal.org.
